exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md describes thread search result clicks routing locally to a panel scroll, not through a canonical route payload
Search result activation must route through the canonical route-target model so cross-surface search works identically regardless of which surface the user is on
notes: FinalGUISpec.md thread search result click model uses surface-local routing; must be refactored to route through canonical route_target contract

exact_items: usage-feature.md and Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md implement 'Show in *' as view-specific deep links rather than as activations of the canonical route-target model
All 'Show in Panel', 'Show in Usage', 'Show in Artifacts' surface actions must be modeled as route-target activations with the appropriate target_kind and identifiers
notes: 'Show in *' deep links are surface-specific implementations of what should be canonical route-target activations. All three docs must align to the route_target model.

exact_items: UI_Command_Catalog.md artifact pivots, usage pivots, and panel pivots all lack a canonical target model — they use per-command arg shapes
All pivot commands must adopt the route_target canonical shape so pivot behavior is consistent and cross-surface verification is possible
notes: UI_Command_Catalog.md pivot command families need a canonical target model based on route_target rather than per-command bespoke arg shapes

exact_items: Export flows across storage-plan.md, usage-feature.md, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md, and FinalGUISpec.md all lack a shared identity-preserving manifest discipline
Exported bundles must carry identity-preserving manifests that reference canonical IDs (project_id, attempt_id, run_id, thread_id) rather than reconstructed or opaque identifiers
notes: Export bundles must include a manifest with canonical IDs. Currently no doc owns the export manifest discipline; storage-plan.md is the natural owner.

exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md and assistant-chat-design.md CTA and attention surfaces use local field conventions rather than the shared route-target model
CtA items and attention-required notifications must carry route_target payloads so they can be activated through the canonical navigation model
notes: CtA and attention-required items must be redesigned to carry route_target payloads; surface-local field conventions are incompatible with cross-surface navigation

exact_items: storage-plan.md uses resume_url as a semi-canonical route reference, but this special-casing reinforces the architecture inversion already flagged in shard-0058
storage-plan.md must be updated to treat resume_url as a serialized transport form only, never as the canonical route model
notes: storage-plan.md resume_url usage reinforces architecture inversion flagged in shard-0058 seed-WAVE006-0074. Confirmed two-doc fix required.

exact_items: Crosswalk.md §2 routing table is missing Primitive:RouteTarget and Primitive:OpenSubject
Without routing entries for RouteTarget and OpenSubject, adjacent docs that reference these primitives have no canonical resolution path through Crosswalk
notes: Crosswalk.md must add Primitive:RouteTarget and Primitive:OpenSubject routing entries. These are foundational primitives referenced by multiple surface and contract docs.

exact_items: All attention/CtA/search-result/usage-pivot activation surfaces in FinalGUISpec.md, UI_Command_Catalog.md, and Orchestrator_Page.md should route through the canonical route-target model, but currently each surface has its own activation semantics
Create a cross-surface activation contract so all surfaces implement the same canonical route-target model for navigation and object focus
notes: Cross-surface activation contract is needed: attention, CtA, search, usage-pivot, artifact Show-in-* all activate through route_target. Contracts_V0.md should own the canonical shape; FinalGUISpec.md / UI_Command_Catalog.md / Orchestrator_Page.md should reference it.

exact_items: Project_Output_Artifacts.md export manifest discipline applies to general app bundle exports but currently only describes output artifact containers, not general exports
Extend the export manifest discipline to cover general app bundle exports with identity-preserving canonical IDs
notes: Project_Output_Artifacts.md manifest discipline should extend to general app bundle exports, not just output artifact containers. Identity-preserving canonical IDs must be required in all exported bundles.
